verdict.rationale: Datadog has first-party documentation for Service Level Objectives and for Monitors, so defining SLOs is its own documented capability. The pack gives only page titles, though, with no content showing error budgets or burn-rate alerting. Missing for 10: evidence of error budget tracking, evidence of burn-rate alert configuration, any independent or hands-on corroboration of SLO workflows.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can define SLOs with error budgets and burn-rate alerts
